attributes.name: Manufacturer
attributes.description: The company that makes the product.
attributes.question: Who makes it?

attributes.name: Model
attributes.description: Official model name as published by the manufacturer.
attributes.question: What is the official model name?

attributes.name: Variant
attributes.description: Sub-model or configuration when listed separately by the manufacturer.
attributes.question: Which sub-model or configuration is this?

attributes.name: Aliases
attributes.question: What else do people call it?

attributes.name: Segment
attributes.description: Buyer groups that would plausibly buy this at list price.
attributes.question: Which of these groups would plausibly buy this at list price?

attributes.name: Application group
attributes.description: Top level of the two-level application vocabulary; derived from application values.
attributes.question: Derived — do not set by hand.

attributes.name: Application
attributes.description: What the product is marketed to do. Each value belongs to one application group.
attributes.question: What is it marketed to do?

attributes.name: ISO 8373 category
attributes.description: Intended-use class under ISO 8373:2021, as positioned by the manufacturer.
attributes.question: Does the manufacturer position it as an industrial, service or medical robot?

attributes.name: Environment
attributes.description: Environments the product is rated to operate in.
attributes.question: Where is it rated to operate?

attributes.name: Autonomy
attributes.description: Highest level of unsupervised operation supported out of the box.
attributes.question: What is the highest level of unsupervised operation out of the box?

attributes.name: Collaborative
attributes.description: Rated for unguarded operation alongside people (ISO 10218 / ISO/TS 15066).
attributes.question: Is it rated for unguarded operation alongside people?

attributes.name: Availability
attributes.description: Whether the product can be bought today.
attributes.question: Can you buy it today?

attributes.name: Price
attributes.description: List price as published. Must be accompanied by currency, price_date and price_source.
attributes.question: What is the published list price?

attributes.name: Currency
attributes.question: In which currency is the price published?

attributes.name: Price date
attributes.question: When was the price observed?

attributes.name: Price source
attributes.description: URL where the price was observed.
attributes.question: Where was the price observed?

attributes.name: Release year
attributes.question: When was it first commercially available?

attributes.name: Country
attributes.question: Where is the manufacturer headquartered?

attributes.name: Mass
attributes.question: What is the specified mass?

attributes.name: Payload
attributes.description: Rated payload. Arm: at the wrist. Mobile robot: on the deck. End-effector: held object.
attributes.question: What is the rated payload?

attributes.name: Battery runtime
attributes.question: What is the manufacturer-rated battery runtime?

attributes.name: IP rating
attributes.question: What IP rating does the spec sheet state?

attributes.name: Open source
attributes.description: Which parts of the product are published under an open licence.
attributes.question: Is the hardware and/or software open source?

attributes.name: SDK
attributes.question: Which SDKs or frameworks are officially supported?

attributes.name: Compatible with
attributes.description: Robots or components officially supported together with this product.
attributes.question: What is it officially compatible with?

attributes.name: Sources
attributes.description: URL and date for each fact.
attributes.question: Where did each fact come from?

attributes.name: Axes
attributes.description: Number of controlled axes. Arm: joints. Force-torque sensor: measured axes.
attributes.question: How many axes does the spec sheet state?

attributes.name: Reach
attributes.question: What is the maximum reach?

attributes.name: Repeatability
attributes.question: What repeatability does the spec sheet state?

attributes.name: Arm count
attributes.description: Number of arms on the product.
attributes.question: How many arms does it have?

attributes.name: Mounting
attributes.description: Positions in which an arm can be mounted.
attributes.question: Where can it be mounted?

attributes.name: Height
attributes.question: What is the standing height?

attributes.name: Total DOF
attributes.description: Total degrees of freedom, excluding hands.
attributes.question: How many degrees of freedom, excluding hands?

attributes.name: Hands included
attributes.description: What end-effectors ship with the robot.
attributes.question: What hands or grippers are included?

attributes.name: Max speed
attributes.question: What is the maximum speed?

attributes.name: Wheel feet
attributes.description: Legged robot with wheels on its feet.
attributes.question: Does it have wheels on its feet?

attributes.name: Has arm
attributes.description: An arm is available as an add-on.
attributes.question: Is an arm available as an add-on?

attributes.name: Drive configuration
attributes.description: How a ground base steers and propels itself.
attributes.question: What drive configuration does the spec sheet state?

attributes.name: Navigation
attributes.question: How does it navigate?

attributes.name: Flight time
attributes.question: What is the rated flight time?

attributes.name: Max take-off weight
attributes.question: What is the maximum take-off weight?

attributes.name: Depth rating
attributes.question: What is the maximum rated depth?

attributes.name: Body region
attributes.description: Body regions a wearable robot acts on.
attributes.question: Which body regions does it act on?

attributes.name: Uses components
attributes.description: Separately listed components this product is built from (e.g. a hand's actuators).
attributes.question: Which listed components is it built from?

attributes.name: Flange standard
attributes.description: Mechanical mounting interface standard between a component and a robot.
attributes.question: Which flange standard does it mount to?

attributes.name: Interface
attributes.question: Which interfaces does it offer?

attributes.name: Voltage
attributes.question: What is the nominal supply voltage?

attributes.name: Actuation
attributes.description: Energy source that drives the component.
attributes.question: How is it actuated?

attributes.name: Grip force
attributes.question: What is the maximum grip force?

attributes.name: Stroke
attributes.description: Total travel. Gripper: jaw opening. Linear actuator: output travel.
attributes.question: What is the total stroke?

attributes.name: Finger count
attributes.question: How many fingers or jaws?

attributes.name: DOF
attributes.question: How many active degrees of freedom?

attributes.name: Tactile sensing
attributes.question: Does it have built-in tactile sensing?

attributes.name: Rated torque
attributes.question: What is the continuous rated torque?

attributes.name: Peak torque
attributes.question: What is the peak torque?

attributes.name: Reducer type
attributes.question: What type of reducer does it use?

attributes.name: Gear ratio
attributes.description: Reduction ratio expressed as N in N:1.
attributes.question: What is the reduction ratio?

attributes.name: Rated force
attributes.question: What is the rated force?

attributes.name: Stall torque
attributes.question: What is the stall torque?

attributes.name: Bus
attributes.question: Which bus does the servo use?

attributes.name: Modality
attributes.question: Which imaging modalities does it provide?

attributes.name: Scan dimensions
attributes.description: Whether a lidar scans a plane or a volume.
attributes.question: Is it a 2D or 3D lidar?

attributes.name: Range
attributes.question: What is the maximum range?

attributes.name: AI performance
attributes.question: What peak AI performance does the spec sheet state?

attributes.name: Capacity
attributes.question: What is the energy capacity?

attributes.name: Teleoperation type
attributes.question: What kind of teleoperation device is it?
